sections.text: Introduction

This 
document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, to be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block

The air compressors are used to supply the station with service air and 
instrument air

The first draft is initiated by eng. Ayman El-kholy, tested by eng. Shafik 
El-nagger, accepted by by general Manager eng. Salah Abd Elwahab El-wekeel, and 
approved by eng. Mahmoud Saad Balbaa: head sector of 
Damanhour Power Station.

This document certified by 
eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC Engineering Consultant A and supervisor on inspection & quality control head sector 
and MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the motor of this compressor.
Isolate the electrical cable feeding the motor of this compressor.
The compressor must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery valve.
Close the cooling water supply.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Intake Filter

Visually inspect inlet air 
filter elements and replace if necessary. Check the filter housing for corrosion 
and check the sealing surface.
Remove the housing cover.
Remove dirty cartridge.

Clean bottom seal plate in 
base of filter housing.

Oil Filter

The compressor has 
hydraulic type filter the filter is mounted down stream of the cooler and 
thermo static control valve.

Visually inspect and 
replace the oil filter element. A single line type oil filter is furnished 
consisting of a 10 micron replaceable cartridge element.

sections.text: Oil Cooler

Visually inspect the oil 
cooler tubes.

Carefully examine tubes 
for scale and clean if necessary. After cleaning, examine for erosion or 
corrosion.

After maintenance 
inspection or cleaning, both shell and tube side should be carefully vented and 
full of liquid.
